Hello, to shorten the waiting time for my new iPhone 16 Pro, I have designed a case with a “clean” design. I specially designed it so that it is flexible enough to print it from PLA and be able to attach it easily. I designed it based on the measurements that are known and hope it fits. But as soon as I get it on 20.9 I will test whether everything fits and then make changes if necessary that it fits perfectly.
